# 0.4 - MaxResetLoopCounter added
# 0.3 - Optional ERR filtersets added, reported faults added
# 0.2 - Pass/warning/fail categories introduced
# 0.1 - Initial version
#
# Usage: <set name>:selected:split:hide:ignore:criteria[operator|limit|state]:file_filter[<filter>]:to_summary[<identifier>]      VALUES SET<set number>="<set filter><::::ignore filter>"
#
# Parameters: ( m=mandatory, o=optional )
#   <set name>                        (m)  name of the set (NOTE! , character not allowed here)
#   :selected                         (o)  selected as ON by default (remove if wanted OFF by default)
#   :split                            (m)  control character
#   :hide                             (o)  hide results by default
#   :ignore                           (o)  if hits found, it won't affect to end result
#   :criteria[operator|limit|state]   (o)  criteria (3 max, each for every state, fail/warning/pass)
#                                          operator: diff operator (<, >, !=, = or ==)
#                                          limit: filter hit limit
#                                          state: operator & count vs runtime hits => result
#                                                 fail/warning/pass
#   :to_summary[<identifier>]         (o)  stores set runtime hit count with <identifier> name to summary_file (if summary_file set for parsing tool)
#   :file_filter[<filter>]            (o)  set file filter, set what files are parsed for SETx (use egrep regex syntax)
#   <set number>                      (m)  set number
#   <set filter>                      (m)  set filter (use egrep regex syntax)
#   <::::ignore filter>               (o)  set ignore filter, :::: used as separator
#
